ideas.pitch: An on-device computer vision application that tracks student posture during long coding sessions and provides instant haptic and audio corrections to prevent musculoskeletal strain.
ideas.title: AuraCare: Real-Time Assistive Posture & Ergonomics Coach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven live-demo pattern from MediaPipe-based winners, directly appealing to judges looking for tangible health impact within an assistive tech track.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local campus platform that pairs students needing immediate help in specific computer science modules with senior peers available for quick micro-sessions.
ideas.title: EduSync: Localized Peer Skill Exchange and Micro-Mentorship Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses an immediate, relatable pain point for college students at Kalindi College and University of Delhi, guaranteeing strong local empathy from the evaluation panel.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight FinTech portal using verifiable smart contracts to track crowdfunding donations and milestone-based fund releases for college-level innovation projects.
ideas.title: AgriChain Ledger: Transparent Micro-Sponsorship for Student Projects
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings transparency to academic project funding, hitting the sweet spot of a Web3 application that solves a real institutional administrative problem rather than dealing in abstract finance.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and computer vision system designed for campus cafeterias and administrative blocks to monitor live congestion and stream predictive wait times to student mobile devices.
ideas.title: CampusFlow: Automated Crowd & Queue Management with Edge AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard edge-AI processing with a crystal-clear, measurable operational efficiency metric that judges can verify on campus immediately.

ideas.pitch: An open-innovation mapping tool that calculates the lowest-emission public transit and walking routes across Delhi by aggregating real-time air quality metrics and local metro feeds.
ideas.title: EcoRoute Delhi: Dynamic Carbon-Optimized Commute Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a hyper-relevant environmental crisis in Delhi with concrete, quantifiable social impact metrics that resonate strongly with academic evaluation panels.
